interpreted_intent: For this independently allocated randomized arm, test whether a women-in-professional-uniform private security access-control concept remains visibly legible inside a complex biotech-laboratory visitor surge during a fire-alarm credential fallback, while using the supplied portrait only as facial and hair appearance guidance for an original adult fictional subject.
subject: An original adult fictional woman working as a private security access-control officer, with only facial appearance and hair visually guided by the supplied portrait.
setting: The glass entry checkpoint of a biotech laboratory during a fire-alarm credential-system fallback and an adult visitor surge.
event: She compares one adult visitor's temporary credential against a printed fallback roster, marks the entry line, and uses her raised open hand to direct the remaining visitors into one monitored lane.
visual_priorities: immediately legible private security access-control role
coordinated professional security uniform visible from shoulders to trousers
clear credential-checking interaction with roster and temporary pass

baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic vertical editorial photograph inside the glass entry checkpoint of a biotech laboratory during a fire-alarm credential-system fallback. An original adult fictional woman, visually guided only in facial appearance and hair by the supplied portrait—long dark center-parted loose waves, softly arched brows, almond-shaped brown eyes, a straight narrow nose, and natural full lips—works as a clearly legible private security access-control officer. She wears a coordinated charcoal security uniform: structured jacket with shoulder epaulettes and a distinct security insignia, pale blue collared shirt, dark tie, matching trousers, duty belt, and clipped two-way radio. A red alarm beacon flashes above disabled badge turnstiles while a surge of adult visitors forms a controlled queue. She stands at a portable checkpoint table, comparing one visitor’s temporary credential with a printed fallback roster and marking the entry line, while her raised open hand directs the remaining queue toward a single monitored lane. Show the credential, roster, visitor wristband, turnstiles, laboratory access doors, and alert beacon clearly. Use a three-quarter full-body composition, realistic fluorescent emergency lighting, crisp documentary detail, and coherent hands and interactions.
